newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello positive on June inventories, GDP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello positive on June inventories, GDP.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the recent rundown in stocks (inventories) was partly unanticipated, but he saw a positive June quarter for stocks and economic growth.
"It appears as if the rundown in stocks was partly unanticipated," Costello told reporters after the release of national accounts for the March quarter.
He said that if there was no change stocks in the next quarter, stocks would still add one percentage point to GDP growth.

"What you actually see is a rundown in stocks and strong private final demand which indicates in the next quarter you are going to see a very positive outcome in relation to stocks and its effect on the GDP," he said.
